scenarioText: A water pipe bursts during a Science Fair experiment. Your team has 3 minutes to act.

decisions.text: Water is flooding the room. What do you do first?

options.text: Turn off the main water valve
Try to mop up the water
options.outcomeText: The water keeps coming; this fails.

decisions.text: The water is stopped but the floor is wet. What next?

options.text: Place absorbent mats and warning signs
Ignore it and continue the experiment
